claims.question: q1
claims.claim: AIP Logic is a no-code environment for LLM-powered functions that use the Ontology; functions can take Ontology objects or text as inputs and return objects/strings or make Ontology edits.
claims.quote: AIP Logic provides an intuitive interface to leverage the Ontology and LLMs via a Logic function that takes inputs (like Ontology objects or text strings) and can return an output (objects and/or strings) or make edits to the Ontology.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Logic functions can be automated so Ontology edits are either applied automatically or staged for human review.
claims.quote: Logic functions can also be [automated](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/automate/overview/) so that [Ontology edits can be automatically applied or staged for human review](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/logic/aip-logic-integration-automate/).

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: AIP Logic's platform security controls grant an LLM access only to what is necessary to complete a task.
claims.quote: These platform security controls grant an LLM access only to what is necessary to complete a task.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The model cannot see data that the user is not authorized to read.
claims.quote: The model can never see data the user is not authorized to read.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Read-time access controls do not extend to the model's output or any Ontology edits it composes.
claims.quote: These controls do not extend to the model's output or any Ontology edits it composes.
